title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Physics - Electromagnetic Waves
subject: Physics

questions.q: An electromagnetic wave travels in free space along the $x$-direction. At a particular point in space and time, $\vec{B} = 2 \times 10^{-7}\hat{j}\text{ T}$ is associated with this wave. The value of corresponding electric field $\vec{E}$ at this point is _______ V/m.
questions.explain:
The direction of propagation of an electromagnetic wave is given by $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$.
Given wave propagates in $+\hat{i}$ direction, and $\vec{B} = B\hat{j}$. Thus, $\hat{E} \times \hat{j} = \hat{i}$. Since $(-\hat{k}) \times \hat{j} = \hat{i}$, the direction of $\vec{E}$ is $-\hat{k}$.
The magnitude of electric field is $E = cB = 3 \times 10^8 \times 2 \times 10^{-7} = 60\text{ V/m}$.
Therefore, $\vec{E} = -60\hat{k}\text{ V/m}$.
